entries.name: updatemany-receiver-lies-errored#0
entries.script: { X.updateMany(Coll(0), Coll(5)) }  // JVM: REJECTS. updateMany clones the receiver's array and assigns each value into it (CollsOverArrays.scala:106-117), so an Int assigned into a long[] clone throws. The exception surfaces wrapped as an InvocationTargetException, the method being reflective

entries.name: updatemany-values-lie-errored#1
entries.script: { Coll(1, 2).updateMany(Coll(0), If(false, Coll(5), Coll(5L))) }  // JVM: REJECTS too, with the lie moved to the VALUES argument instead of the receiver: an honest int[] receiver and a Long value. Both directions throw, unlike append, which has an empty-left escape
